pref_miyagi_matrix_040.hack: For the 1948 original, walk 10 mins to Aji-no-Tasuke Honten in Kokubuncho; for thick slices, hit善治郎 (Zenjiro)!

pref_miyagi_matrix_040.dish: Date Clan National Treasure Zen Monastery & Heart-Shaped Stone Moss Gardens (★4.8)
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.hack: Make your own natural stone prayer bracelet (Juzu) inside Entsuin Temple before walking the moss garden

pref_miyagi_matrix_040.name_en: Shiogama Shrine & Shiogama Sushi Street (Shiogama, Miyagi)
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.dish: 1,200-Year Guardian Shrine of Tohoku + Highest Density of Top-Tier Sushi Shops in Japan! (★4.7)
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.hack: Climb the 202 stone steps of Omote-zaka, see the rare 'Shiogama-zakura' cherry tree, then eat at Sushitetsu!

pref_miyagi_matrix_040.name_en: Geibikei / Akiu Great Falls & Rairaikyo Gorge (Sendai Akiu, Miyagi)
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.dish: 55-Meter-High, 6-Meter-Wide Roaring Waterfall & Heart-Shaped Eroded Canyon 30 Mins From Sendai (★4.7)
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.access_short: JR Sendai Stn 40m Bus to Akiu
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.hack: Pick up the famous 'Saichi Ohagi' (sweet red-bean or sesame rice cakes — sells 20,000 a day!) at主婦の店さいち in Akiu!

pref_miyagi_matrix_040.dish: Car-Free Fishing Island Where 150 Friendly Cats Outnumber Residents & Guard the 'Cat Shrine' (★4.6)
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.access_short: JR Ishinomaki Stn 15m Bus to Central Pier
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.hack: Get off at Nitoda Port (2nd stop) and walk the forest road up to 'Neko-Jinja' (Cat Shrine) in the island center

pref_miyagi_matrix_040.name_en: Nikka Whisky Miyagikyo Distillery (Sendai Aoba, Miyagi)
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.dish: Masataka Taketsuru's Red-Brick Highland Valley Distillery With Guided Tour & Single Malt Tasting (★4.8)
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.budget: Free Guided Tour (+¥500–¥1,000 Rare Malt Flight)
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.access_short: JR Sakunami Stn 7m Free Shuttle Bus
pref_miyagi_matrix_040.hack: Book your free 60-minute distillery tour online in advance and taste the distillery-exclusive Single Malt at the bar!

pref_iwate_matrix_041.name_en: Chuson-ji Temple & Konjikido Golden Hall (Hiraizumi, Iwate)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: 1124 UNESCO Pure-Gold-Leaf Hall Built as a Buddhist Pure Land by the Northern Fujiwara Clan (★4.8)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.access_short: JR Hiraizumi Stn 7m Loop Bus / 20m Walk
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: Rent a ¥500 bicycle right outside JR Hiraizumi Station to connect Chuson-ji, Motsu-ji, and Takkoku-no-Iwaya!

pref_iwate_matrix_041.name_en: Motsu-ji Pure Land Pond Garden (Hiraizumi, Iwate)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: 850 AD Heian-Era 'Jodo' Garden Centered on Oizケ池 Pond With Curved Pebble Beaches (★4.7)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: Look at the 'Dejima' stone peninsula jutting into the pond — preserved virtually untouched since the 12th century

pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: 801 AD Vermilion Temple Built on Wooden Stilts Directly Inside a Giant Overhanging Cliff Cave (★4.8)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: Look left of the cliff temple to spot the 16.5-meter 'Gamen Daibutsu' Buddha face carved into the rock in 1062!

pref_iwate_matrix_041.name_en: Geibikei Gorge Singing Boat Ride (Ichinoseki, Iwate)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: 90-Minute Hand-Poled Wooden Boat Through 100-Meter Limestone Cliffs Echoing With 'Geibi Oiwake' Folk Songs (★4.8)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: In winter (Dec–Feb), the boats are fitted with warm 'Kotatsu' heated tables and serve hot simmered miso pot!

pref_iwate_matrix_041.name_en: Jodogahama Beach — Pure Land White Rocks (Miyako, Iwate)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: 52-Million-Year White Rhyolite Spires Rising From Crystal-Emerald Pacific Cove Waters (★4.8)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.budget: Free Beach (¥1,500 Blue Cave Sappa Boat)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: Board the small fisherman-steered 'Sappa-bune' boat with a helmet to enter the glowing Blue Cave ('Hachinohe-ana')!

pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: L-Shaped 'Nambu Magariya' Thatched Horse-and-Family Farmhouses in Japan's Folklore Valley (★4.7)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: Step inside a 'Magariya' house where prized farm horses lived under the exact same thatched roof as the family!

pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: Underground River Cavern With 98-Meter-Deep Glowing 'Dragon Blue' Subterranean Lakes (★4.8)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: Bring a sweater — the underground boardwalk over the 3 glowing blue lakes stays 10°C year-round!

pref_iwate_matrix_041.name_en: Morioka Castle Ruins & Azumaya Wanko Soba (Morioka, Iwate)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: 3-River Granite Castle Walls + All-You-Can-Slurp Bite-Sized 'Wanko Soba' Bowl Challenge! (★4.7)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.budget: Free Castle Park (¥3,800 Wanko Soba at Azumaya)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: Hit 100 bowls at Azumaya Honten (equals ~6 regular bowls) to receive a solid wooden Certificate Plaque!

pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: 2km Basalt Emerald Rapids Where Your Dango Order Flies Across the Gorge on a Rope! (★4.7)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: Put ¥500 in the bamboo basket on the pavilion rock and bang the wooden mallet — they zip-line dango and tea back across!

pref_iwate_matrix_041.name_en: Hanamaki Onsenkyo — Osawa Onsen Sansuikaku (Hanamaki, Iwate)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.dish: 200-Year-Old Open-Sided 'Osawa-no-Yu' Wooden Bath Perched Directly Over the Toyosawa River (★4.8)
pref_iwate_matrix_041.hack: Walk across the curved wooden bridge to the thatched 'Toji-ya' wing loved by poet Kenji Miyazawa

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Ginzan Onsen Gaslit Ryokan Town (Obanazawa, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: Iconic 1920s Multi-Story Timber Bathhouses Along the Steaming Ginzan River (★4.9)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: Walk 10 minutes past the last ryokan up to the 22-meter Shirogane Waterfall and old silver mine caves!

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Yamadera — Risshaku-ji Cliff Temple (Yamagata City, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: 1,015 Stone Steps Climbing Through Giant Cedars to the Precipice 'Godaido' Hall (★4.9)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: After descending the 1,015 steps, eat 'Chikara Konnyaku' (soy-braised konjac balls on a stick) for ¥100 at the base!

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Zao Snow Monsters (Juhyo) & Zao Onsen (Yamagata City, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: Thousands of Frozen Fir Trees Sculpted by Siberian Winds + Milky-Green Sulfur Springs (★4.8)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: Visit between late January and mid-February and ride to Jizo Summit Station (1,661m) on a clear afternoon

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Hagurosan 2,446 Cedar Stone Steps & Pagoda (Tsuruoka, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: Michelin 3-Star Pilgrimage Trail Through 500-Year Cryptomeria Trees & 1372 Pagoda (★4.9)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.access_short: JR Tsuruoka Stn 38m Bus to Zuishinmon
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: Pause halfway up at 'Nino-Saka Chaya' thatched teahouse for freshly pounded Chikara-Mochi and matcha overlooking the plain!

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Kamo Aquarium — World's #1 Jellyfish Dream Theater (Tsuruoka, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: 80 Species of Glowing Jellyfish Including a 5-Meter Circular Window of 10,000 Moon Jellies! (★4.8)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: Try the 'Jellyfish Ramen' and 'Jellyfish Ice Cream' (crunchy texture!) at the ocean-view restaurant upstairs

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Sankyo Soko Rice Storehouses & Somaro Maiko House (Sakata, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: 1893 Row of 12 Black-Timber Rice Granaries Shaded by 150-Year Zelkova Trees (★4.6)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: Walk 10 minutes to Somaro to watch a live 'Sakata Maiko' dance inside a restored Edo-period red-lacquer teahouse

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Mogami River Singing Boat Ride (Tozawa, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: 12km Year-Round River Gorge Cruise Where Boatmen Sing the Echoing 'Mogamigawa Funauta' (★4.6)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.access_short: JR Furukuchi Stn 7m Walk to Pier
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: From December to March, ride the warm 'Kotatsu Boat' through the snowy white canyon!

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Tendo Shogi Town & Human Shogi Castle (Tendo, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: Produces 95% of Japan's Wooden Shogi Chess Pieces — Footbaths & Pear Orchards (★4.5)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: Paint your own auspicious 'Hidari-Uma' (Left-Facing Horse) wooden shogi piece at Eishun-do right near the station

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Uesugi Shrine & Yonezawa A5 Beef Town (Yonezawa, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: Samurai Moat Shrine of Uesugi Kenshin + Melt-in-Mouth Yonezawa Beef Sukiyaki at Tokiwa-ro (★4.7)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: Dine at Tokiwa-ro (founded 1894) or登起波 (Tokiwa) for their weekday Yonezawa Beef Sukiyaki or Gyudon lunch!

pref_yamagata_matrix_042.name_en: Dewa Sanzan — Yudonosan Sacred Hot-Spring Boulder (Tsuruoka, Yamagata)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.dish: Holiest Peak of Shugendo Where Pilgrims Walk Barefoot Over a Gushing Orange Hot-Spring Rock! (★4.8)
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.access_short: JR Tsuruoka Stn Bus to Yudonosan
pref_yamagata_matrix_042.hack: Photography is strictly forbidden at the sacred boulder ('Speak Not of Yudonosan') — you walk barefoot in warm mineral water!

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: 5,087 Intricate Gold-Leaf Carvings Including the Sleeping Cat & Three Wise Monkeys (★4.9)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Find the single 'Upside-Down Pillar' (Sakasa-bashira) on Yomeimon Gate — carved upside down on purpose so the gate never reaches perfection and falls!

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.name_en: Ashikaga Flower Park Great Wisteria (Ashikaga, Tochigi)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: 1,000㎡ Purple Wisteria Canopy & 80m White Tunnel Just 70 Mins From Tokyo (★4.9)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.access_short: JR Ashikaga Flower Park Stn 3m Walk
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Visit in late April/early May for Wisteria, or November–February for the 'Garden of Illuminated Flowers' (5 million LEDs!)

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.name_en: Oya History Museum — Underground Stone Cathedral (Utsunomiya, Tochigi)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: 30m-Deep Subterranean Oya-Stone Cavern Used for Concerts, Films & 'Rurouni Kenshin' (★4.8)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.access_short: JR Utsunomiya Stn West Exit 30m Bus
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Right across the street, see the 27-meter 'Heiwa Kannon' statue hand-carved directly into the cliff wall!

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: 97-Meter Plunging Waterfall Reached by a 100-Meter Bedrock Elevator (★4.8)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.access_short: JR/Tobu Nikko Stn 45m Bus via Irohazaka
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Eat a freshly grilled 'Yuba Croquette' and salted char fish on a stick while waiting at the Kegon Falls plaza

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.name_en: Shinkyo Sacred Vermilion Bridge & Kanmangafuchi Abyss (Nikko, Tochigi)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: 1636 Lacquered Bridge Over the Turquoise Daiya River + 70 Mossy Red-Bibbed 'Bake-Jizo' Statues (★4.7)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Walk 15 minutes past Shinkyo Bridge to the quiet Kanmangafuchi Gorge where 70 stone Jizo line the roaring rapids!

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.name_en: Utsunomiya Gyoza Street — Minmin & Masashi (Utsunomiya, Tochigi)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: Japan's Gyoza Capital: Crispy-Wing Pan-Fried Yaki-Gyoza, Sui-Gyoza & Age-Gyoza for ¥300! (★4.6)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.access_short: JR Utsunomiya Stn West Exit 1m / Kirasse
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Skip choosing just one shop — go to 'Kirasse' (MEGA Don Quijote B1F) where all 5 top gyoza brands serve on one table!

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: Shoji Hamada's Folk-Craft Ceramic Capital With 400 Kilns & Thatch-Roof Heritage Homestead (★4.6)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Browse Jonaizaka Slope's 30 ceramic galleries and see the giant 8-chamber climbing kiln (Noborigama)

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.name_en: Nasu Highland & Sessho-seki Nine-Tailed Fox Stone (Nasu, Tochigi)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: Steaming Volcanic Boulder Valley & 1,390-Year Wooden 'Shika-no-Yu' Sulfur Bath (★4.7)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Stop at Shooters or Penny Lane Bakery in the Nasu forest on your way up for their legendary Blueberry Bread!

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: 200 Black-and-White Edo Merchant Storehouses Along the Carp-Filled Uzuma River (★4.6)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Visit the 'Kura-no-Machi Dashi Kaikan' to see the towering gold-embroidered festival floats up close
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.photo_query: Tochigi Kura no Machi river boat

pref_tochigi_matrix_043.dish: Deep Mountain Valley Founded by Defeated Taira Samurai With Irori Hearth Cuisine (★4.7)
pref_tochigi_matrix_043.hack: Cross the suspension bridge to the thatched village and try 'Bandai-mochi' grilled over charcoal

pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: Steaming Emerald Hot-Spring Field & Traditional Wooden-Paddle 'Yumomi' Song Show (★4.9)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: After the Yumomi show, walk up through Sainokawara Park's steaming hot-spring river to the giant outdoor bath!

pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: Terraced Mountain Hot Spring Street & 'Mizusawa Udon' — One of Japan's 3 Great Udon Noodles (★4.7)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.budget: Free Steps (¥1,300 Mizusawa Udon at Tamaruya)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: Stop 5 minutes below Ikaho at Mizusawa Temple to eat glossy, translucent 'Mizusawa Udon' with sesame dipping sauce!

pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: 4 Giant Open-Air Stone Baths Flanking a Roaring Mountain River Gorge (★4.8)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: Try both 'Maka-no-Yu' (120 tatami mats) and 'Maya-no-Yu' (ladies-only 100-tatami pool)

pref_gunma_matrix_044.name_en: Shima Onsen Sekizenkan & Lake Okushima (Nakanojo, Gunma)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: 1691 Red Bridge to Japan's Oldest Ryokan Bathhouse + Glowing Cobalt-Blue Dam Lake (★4.8)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: Step inside the 1930 'Genroku-no-Yu' arched hall where 5 stone tubs sit directly on the thermal source

pref_gunma_matrix_044.name_en: Tomioka Silk Mill UNESCO World Heritage Site (Tomioka, Gunma)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: 1872 Red-Brick Timber-Truss Filature That Launched Japan's Modern Industrial Revolution (★4.6)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: Inspect the 100-meter-long column-free reeling hall built with French red bricks and Japanese cedar!

pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: 1,400-Year Shinto Sanctuary Wedged Into Giant Volcanic Pinnacles + 'Initial D' Mountain Pass (★4.8)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: After passing the bronze dragon-carved pillars of the main hall, dip your fortune paper in the sacred stream!

pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: 30-Meter-Wide Horse-Shoe Chasm Where the River Plunges Into a Volcanic Fault Crack (★4.7)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: Cross the Ukishima Bridge to complete the full 1-hour circular canyon trail

pref_gunma_matrix_044.name_en: Usui Pass Railway Heritage & Megane-bashi (Annaka, Gunma)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: 1892 Japan's Largest 4-Arch Red-Brick Railway Viaduct (2 Million Bricks!) & Abt-Rack Trail (★4.8)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.access_short: JR Yokokawa Stn 15m Walk along Abt Trail
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: Buy Japan's oldest Ekiben station lunchbox — 'Toge no Kamameshi' in a real earthenware pot — right outside Yokokawa Station!

pref_gunma_matrix_044.name_en: Shorinzan Daruma-ji — Birthplace of Lucky Daruma Dolls (Takasaki, Gunma)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: 1697 Zen Temple Piled High With Thousands of Red Wishing Daruma Dolls (★4.6)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.budget: Free Temple (¥500 Paint Your Own Daruma)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: Paint in the LEFT eye of your Daruma when making a goal, and paint the right eye once it comes true!

pref_gunma_matrix_044.name_en: Doai Station — Japan's Deepest 'Mole Station' & Mount Tanigawa (Minakami, Gunma)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.dish: 462 Underground Concrete Steps Descending 70 Meters Inside a Mountain Tunnel! (★4.7)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.access_short: JR Doai Stn 0m (10m Walk to Ropeway)
pref_gunma_matrix_044.hack: Experience the eerie 10-minute climb up the 462 tunnel stairs, then ride the Tanigawa Ropeway right next door!

pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: Willow-Lined Ono River 'Little Edo' Where Cartographer Ino Tadataka Lived & Brewed Sake (★4.8)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: Visit Tokun Sake Brewery or Basho-an for freshly grilled unagi and sweet-soy Mitarashi dango

pref_chiba_matrix_045.name_en: Mount Nokogiri Nihon-ji — Cliff of Hell & Stone Daibutsu (Kyonan, Chiba)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: 100m Overhanging 'Jigoku-Nozoki' Cliff Spur & 31-Meter Carved Stone Great Buddha (★4.8)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: Look for the 100-foot Kannon relief carved inside the vertical quarry canyon on the north gate side!

pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: 800m Edo Pilgrimage Street Leading to a 940 AD Shingon Temple & 3-Story Pagoda (★4.8)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: Don't miss the peaceful 165,000㎡ Naritasan Park behind the main hall with 3 ponds and waterfalls!

pref_chiba_matrix_045.name_en: Katsuura Morning Market & Katsuura Tantanmen (Katsuura, Chiba)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: 430-Year-Old Daily Seafood & Produce Street Market + Fiery Chili-Onion 'Katsuura Tantanmen' (★4.6)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: After walking the morning market (6:30–11:00 AM), climb the 60 stone steps of Tomisaki Shrine during Hina Season!

pref_chiba_matrix_045.name_en: Kominato Railway & Isumi Railway — Retro Yellow Trains (Ichihara / Otaki, Chiba)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: 1960s Diesel Railcars Chugging Through Golden Rapeseed Blossoms & Persimmon Valleys (★4.7)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: Get off at Kazusa-Nakano Station where the red-and-cream Kominato train meets the bright yellow Isumi train!

pref_chiba_matrix_045.name_en: Inubosaki Lighthouse & Choshi Tuna Port (Choshi, Chiba)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: 1874 White Brick Lighthouse on a Dramatic Cretaceous Rock Cape + Choshi Electric Railway (★4.6)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.access_short: Choshi Electric Railway Inubo Stn 7m Walk
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: Riding the 6.4km Choshi Electric Railway and buying a ¥500 pack of 'Nure-Senbei' literally keeps this beloved railway alive!

pref_chiba_matrix_045.name_en: Kamogawa Seaworld & Oyama Senmaida Rice Terraces (Kamogawa, Chiba)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: 375 Curved Rain-Fed Mountain Rice Terraces Closer to Tokyo Than Any Other in Japan (★4.6)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: Visit in May when the 375 stepped paddies mirror the blue sky like 375 shards of glass!

pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: 643 BC Black-Lacquer & Gold Warrior God Shrine Under 1,000-Year Cedar Trees + Earthquake-Pinning 'Kaname-ishi' (★4.8)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: Visit the 'Kaname-ishi' (Keystone Rock) believed in Japanese myth to pin down the giant underground earthquake catfish!

pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: Sunlight Streaming Through a Cave Arch to Form a Glowing Heart Reflection on the Stream! (★4.5)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: Arrive between 6:30 AM and 7:30 AM on a clear morning when the sun angle creates the golden heart reflection!

pref_chiba_matrix_045.name_en: Hoki Museum — Cantilevered Realism Gallery (Midori-ku, Chiba)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.dish: 100-Meter Floating Steel Tube Gallery Built Beside Showa Forest Park (★4.7)
pref_chiba_matrix_045.access_short: JR Toke Stn South Exit 5m Bus
pref_chiba_matrix_045.hack: Walk to the very end of Gallery 1 where the 30-meter corridor cantilevers in mid-air with zero support pillars underneath!

pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.name_en: Sumatakyo Gorge Dream Suspension Bridge (Kawanehoncho, Shizuoka)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.dish: 90-Meter Wooden Plank Bridge Swaying Above a Milky-Turquoise Alpine Lake (★4.8)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.hack: The route is a one-way loop (90 minutes total walk) — wear sneakers as there are 304 stairs on the return climb!

pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.name_en: Oigawa Railway — Okuoikojo 'Floating Lake Station' (Kawanehoncho, Shizuoka)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.dish: Tiny Red Abt-Rack Train Crossing a High Steel Trestle onto a Peninsula Surrounded by Emerald Water (★4.9)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.hack: Walk across the pedestrian lane right beside the railway tracks onto the cliff viewpoint BEFORE the next train arrives!

pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.name_en: Kunozan Tosho-gu & Nihondaira Yume Terrace (Shizuoka City, Shizuoka)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.dish: Kengo Kuma Timber Observation Deck Over Mt. Fuji & Suruga Bay + Ropeway to Ieyasu's Golden Shrine (★4.8)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.hack: Have locally grown Shizuoka green tea at the 2F lounge of Nihondaira Yume Terrace while framing Mt. Fuji

pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.name_en: Shiraito Falls & Fujisan Hongu Sengen Taisha (Fujinomiya, Shizuoka)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.dish: 150-Meter-Wide Curtain of Thousands of Silky Mt. Fuji Snowmelt Streams + Fujinomiya Yakisoba (★4.8)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.hack: After Shiraito Falls, eat chewy steamed-noodle 'Fujinomiya Yakisoba' topped with sardine powder right outside Sengen Taisha!

pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.name_en: Shuzenji Onsen Bamboo Path & Katsura Bridge (Izu, Shizuoka)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.dish: 5 Red Lacquered Bridges Spanning the Katsura River Through a 1,200-Year Hot Spring Town (★4.7)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.hack: If you walk across all 5 red bridges in Shuzenji while making a wish, local legend says love wishes come true!

pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.name_en: Jogasaki Coast Cliff Trail & Kadowaki Suspension Bridge (Ito, Shizuoka)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.dish: 4,000-Year Volcanic Lava Columns & 48-Meter Bridge Suspended 23m Above Crashing Waves (★4.7)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.hack: Walk the forested 2km 'Picnic Course' along the jagged black basalt cliffs from the bridge to Izu-Kogen

pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.dish: 7km Black-Sand Beach Lined With 30,000 Ancient Pines Looking Across the Sea to Mt. Fuji (★4.7)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.hack: Walk the 'Kami-no-Michi' (Path of the Gods) boardwalk made of fragrant cypress wood leading from Miho Shrine to the beach

pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.name_en: Dogashima Tensodo Blue Sea Cave & Sanshiro Islands (Nishi-Izu, Shizuoka)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.dish: Boat Cruise Entering a Skylight Sea Cave + Natural 'Tombolo' Land Bridge Appearing at Low Tide (★4.7)
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.access_short: Izu Kyuko Rendaiji Stn 40m Tokai Bus
pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.hack: Also climb the cliff path above the cave to look straight down through the natural ceiling hole into the emerald water!

pref_shizuoka_matrix_046.dish: 1,500 Stone-Stepped Mountain-Stream Wasabi Paddy Terraces Fed by Pure Mt. Amagi Spring Water (★4.6)

pref_aichi_matrix_047.name_en: Inuyama Castle & Castle Town Skewers (Inuyama, Aichi)

pref_aichi_matrix_047.name_en: Yabaton Miso-Katsu & Yamachan Tebasaki (Sakae / Nagoya Station, Aichi)

pref_aichi_matrix_047.name_en: handa Canal Black-Wall Vinegar & Sake Warehouses (Handa, Aichi)

pref_mie_matrix_048.name_en: Ise Jingu — Naiku & Uji Bridge (Ise, Mie)

pref_mie_matrix_048.name_en: Okage Yokocho & Oharaimachi Food Street (Ise, Mie)

pref_mie_matrix_048.name_en: Kumano Kodo Iseji — Magose Toge & Maruyama Senmaida (Owase / Kumano, Mie)

pref_mie_matrix_048.name_en: Toba Mikimoto Pearl Island & Ama Diver Hut (Hachiman-kamado) (Toba, Mie)

pref_mie_matrix_048.name_en: Nabana no Sato Flower Park & Tunnel of Light (Kuwana, Mie)

pref_mie_matrix_048.photo_query: Nabana no Sato light tunnel Mie

pref_mie_matrix_048.name_en: Wadakin / Gyugin — Authentic Matsusaka Beef Sukiyaki (Matsusaka, Mie)

pref_shiga_matrix_049.dish: 1622 Original 3-Story National Treasure Keep With Bell-Shaped Windows Overlooking Lake Biwa (★4.8)

pref_shiga_matrix_049.name_en: Omihachiman Hachiman-bori Canal & La Collina (Omihachiman, Shiga)

pref_shiga_matrix_049.name_en: Shirahige Shrine Floating Lake Torii (Takashima, Shiga)

pref_shiga_matrix_049.name_en: Enryaku-ji Temple on Mount Hiei (Otsu, Shiga)

pref_shiga_matrix_049.name_en: Ishiyamadera Temple — Where 'The Tale of Genji' Was Written (Otsu, Shiga)

pref_shiga_matrix_049.name_en: Chikubushima Island — Power-Spot Island in Lake Biwa (Nagahama, Shiga)

pref_shiga_matrix_049.name_en: Nagahama Kurokabe Square & Omi Beef (Nagahama, Shiga)

pref_hyogo_matrix_050.name_en: Himeji Castle & Koko-en Samurai Gardens (Himeji, Hyogo)

pref_hyogo_matrix_050.name_en: Takeda Castle Ruins — Castle in the Sky (Asago, Hyogo)

pref_hyogo_matrix_050.name_en: Arima Onsen — Gold & Silver Springs (Kita-ku, Kobe, Hyogo)

pref_hyogo_matrix_050.name_en: Kobe Steakland / Mouriya A5 Kobe Beef Teppanyaki (Sannomiya, Kobe, Hyogo)

pref_hyogo_matrix_050.name_en: Nada Sake District — Hakutsuru & Kikumasamune Breweries (Higashinada, Kobe, Hyogo)

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.name_en: Koyasan Okunoin & Shukubo Temple Stay (Koyasan, Wakayama)

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.name_en: Kumano Kodo Daimonzaka Cobblestone Staircase (Nachikatsuura, Wakayama)

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.hack: Rent a traditional Heian-period robe ('Heian-isho') at Daimonzaka Chaya for photos between the giant twin cedars!

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.name_en: Kumano Hongu Taisha & Oyunohara Giant Torii (Tanabe Hongu, Wakayama)

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.hack: After visiting the hilltop shrine, walk 10 minutes across the road to stand beneath the colossal black Oyunohara Torii!

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.name_en: Yunomine Onsen Tsuboyu — UNESCO World Heritage Bath (Tanabe Hongu, Wakayama)
pref_wakayama_matrix_051.dish: 1,800-Year-Old Natural River-Rock Cabin Bath — The ONLY World Heritage Site You Can Bathe Inside! (★4.8)

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.hack: Get a numbered ticket at the booth across the creek; the mineral water naturally changes color 7 times a day!

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.name_en: Kawayu Onsen Sennin-Buro Giant River Bath (Tanabe Hongu, Wakayama)
pref_wakayama_matrix_051.dish: 73°C Hot Spring Gushing Straight Through the Riverbed Pebbles — Dig Your Own Pool in the River! (★4.7)

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.name_en: Shirahama Engetsu Island, Senjojiki & Saki-no-Yu (Shirahama, Wakayama)

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.name_en: Kumano Hayatama Taisha & Kamikura Shrine (Shingu, Wakayama)

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.name_en: Wakayama Castle & Tamadensha 'Tama Cat Train' (Wakayama City, Wakayama)

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.access_short: JR Wakayama Stn 0m Transfer to Kishigawa Line
pref_wakayama_matrix_051.hack: Board the 'Tama Museum Train' at Platform 9 inside JR Wakayama Station to meet the real calico Stationmaster Cat at Kishi!

pref_wakayama_matrix_051.name_en: Yuasa Soy Sauce Town — Birthplace of Japanese Shoyu (Yuasa, Wakayama)
pref_wakayama_matrix_051.dish: 1254 Historic Dark-Wood Brewing Lanes Where Monks Discovered Soy Sauce From Kinzanji Miso! (★4.6)
pref_wakayama_matrix_051.hack: Visit Kadocho (founded 1841) to smell 180-year-old cedar vats and try 'Soy Sauce Soft-Serve Ice Cream'!

pref_tottori_matrix_052.name_en: Tottori Sand Dunes & Sand Museum (Tottori City, Tottori)
pref_tottori_matrix_052.dish: 16km Coastal Desert With 50-Meter 'Umanose' Wind-Ridges Over the Cobalt Sea of Japan (★4.8)

pref_tottori_matrix_052.hack: Climb the 50m 'Horseback' ridge before 8:30 AM when the overnight wind ripples on the sand have zero footprints!

pref_tottori_matrix_052.name_en: Mitokusan Sanbutsu-ji Nageiredo Cliff Hall (Misasa, Tottori)

pref_tottori_matrix_052.dish: Red-Stoneware-Tiled Edo Sake & Soy Warehouses Straddling the Koi-Filled Tamakawa Canal (★4.7)
pref_tottori_matrix_052.hack: Try 'ishi-usu' stone-mill coffee where you grind your own beans and dip them in red-bean paste at Kura Cafe!

pref_tottori_matrix_052.name_en: Mizuki Shigeru Road (GeGeGe no Kitaro Town) (Sakaiminato, Tottori)
pref_tottori_matrix_052.dish: 177 Bronze Yokai Statues + Sakaiminato Port 'Matsuba Crab' & Red Snow Crab Stalls (★4.8)
pref_tottori_matrix_052.hack: Walk 10 minutes from the Yokai street to Sakaiminato Seafood Center for ¥2,500 whole boiled Red Snow Crabs!

pref_tottori_matrix_052.name_en: Uradome Coast Emerald Caves & Islands (Iwami, Tottori)
pref_tottori_matrix_052.dish: 25-Meter Crystal-Clear Underwater Visibility Across Sea-Carved Granite Arches & Pine Islets (★4.8)
pref_tottori_matrix_052.hack: Ride the smaller 'Uradome Go' adventure boat that squeezes directly inside the narrow 70cm-clearance sea caves!

pref_tottori_matrix_052.name_en: Mount Daisen & Daisen-ji Temple Approach (Daisen, Tottori)
pref_tottori_matrix_052.dish: 1,729m 'Fuji of Hoki' Volcanic Peak & Mossy Stone-Paved 'Ogamiyama Shrine' Cedar Trail (★4.8)

pref_tottori_matrix_052.name_en: Hakuto Shrine — The White Rabbit of Inaba (Tottori City, Tottori)

pref_tottori_matrix_052.hack: Buy a white rabbit 'Musubi-ishi' wishing stone (¥200) and place it along the stone bridge rail!

pref_tottori_matrix_052.name_en: Tottori Castle Ruins & Jinpukaku French Villa (Tottori City, Tottori)

pref_tottori_matrix_052.hack: Find Japan's ONLY spherical stone wall ('Maki-ishi-gaki') — curved like a globe to prevent landslide collapse!

pref_tottori_matrix_052.name_en: Misasa Onsen Radium Hot Springs (Misasa, Tottori)

pref_tottori_matrix_052.dish: 40-Room Cedar Merchant Estate With a 14-Meter-High Earthen Beam Hall Overlooking 7 Gardens (★4.8)
pref_tottori_matrix_052.hack: Have coffee and cake in the tatami hall looking through full-height antique glass panes at the waterfall garden!

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.name_en: Itsukushima Shrine & Mount Misen Summit (Miyajima, Hiroshima)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: 1168 Floating Vermilion O-Torii Gate & Giant Granite Boulders on 535m Sacred Mount Misen (★4.9)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Your JR Rail Pass covers the JR Miyajima Ferry for free! Eat freshly baked Momiji Manju and Grilled Oysters on Omotesando

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.name_en: Onomichi Senko-ji Temple Slope & Cat Alley (Onomichi, Hiroshima)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: Winding Hillside Labyrinth of 25 Temples, Kominka Cafes & 'Neko no Hosomichi' Over the Inland Sea (★4.9)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Ride the ropeway UP to the spiral 'PEAK' observation deck, then walk DOWN past the boulder tunnel and Cat Alley!

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.name_en: Tomonoura Edo Port & Joyato Stone Lighthouse (Fukuyama, Hiroshima)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: 1859 Stone Harbor, 'Ponyo' Cliff Houses & 'Taichoro' Hall Called the Most Beautiful View in Korea/Japan! (★4.8)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.access_short: JR Fukuyama Stn South Exit 30m Tomotetsu Bus
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Sit on the tatami mat of Fukuzen-ji Taichoro — the wooden window frame acts as a living painting of Bentenjima Island!

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.name_en: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park & Museum (Naka-ku, Hiroshima)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: UNESCO A-Bomb Dome, Cenotaph Flame & Newly Renovated East-Main Building Exhibition (★4.9)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Book your ¥200 timed QR ticket online to enter the main museum without waiting in the morning plaza line

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: Layered Crepe, Steamed Cabbage, Crispy Pork, Soba Noodles & Fried Egg Topped With Sweet Carp Sauce (★4.8)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Order 'Ika-ten' (crispy squid tempura flakes) and green Kujo Negi onions as toppings on your soba okonomiyaki!

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.name_en: Takehara — Little Kyoto of Aki & Bamboo Town (Takehara, Hiroshima)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: 17th-Century Salt & Sake Merchant Mansions With Lattice Windows & Massan Whisky Birthplace (★4.7)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Climb the steps of Saiho-ji Temple's 'Fumeikaku' stage (modeled on Kiyomizu-dera!) overlooking every tiled roof in town

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.name_en: Kosan-ji Temple & 'Hill of Hope' White Marble Garden (Ikuchijima, Onomichi, Hiroshima)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: 5,000㎡ Pure White Carrara Marble Hill Sculpted Over 16 Years Looking Over the Seto Inland Sea! (★4.8)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.access_short: JR Onomichi Stn 40m Ferry to Setoda Port
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Take the 40-minute Setouchi Cruising boat directly from right outside JR Onomichi Station to Setoda Port!
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.photo_query: Kosanji Hill of Hope marble Hiroshima

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.name_en: Sandankyo Gorge Two-Tiered Waterfall Boat (Akiota, Hiroshima)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: 16km Emerald Chasm Where You Ride a Hand-Pulled Wooden Boat Between 30-Meter Sheer Rock Walls (★4.8)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.access_short: JR Hiroshima Stn Bus Center 75m Direct Bus
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Take the 8:18 AM direct express bus from Hiroshima Bus Center to Sandankyo Front Gate

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.name_en: Saijo Sake Brewery Street — Kamotsuru &賀茂泉 (Higashihiroshima, Hiroshima)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: 7 Red-Brick-Chimney Sake Breweries Within 500 Meters Offering Free Well-Water & Daiginjo Tastings! (★4.7)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Eat 'Bishu-nabe' (pork and chicken cooked solely in pure Hiroshima sake, salt, and pepper!) at佛蘭西屋 (Furanshiya)

pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.name_en: Okunoshima — Rabbit Island & Kure Yamato Museum (Takehara / Kure, Hiroshima)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.dish: Car-Free Inland Sea Island Home to 500 Friendly Wild Rabbits + 1/10 Scale Battleship Yamato (★4.6)
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.access_short: JR Tadanoumi Stn 3m Walk to Ferry
pref_hiroshima_matrix_053.hack: Buy rabbit pellet food (¥200) BEFORE boarding the ferry at Tadanoumi Port — no rabbit food is sold on the island!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: Michelin 3-Star 75-Hectare Daimyo Garden With 1,400 Hand-Bonsai-Pruned Pine Trees & 6 Lakes (★4.9)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: Stand on 'Hiraiho' viewpoint hill for the iconic postcard shot of Engetsu-kyo arched bridge over South Lake!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: Maritime Guardian Shrine Climbing Mount Zozu Past Sake Museums, Kabuki Theater & Gold Screens (★4.8)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: Borrow a free bamboo walking stick from the souvenir shops at step #1, and celebrate with a 'Kamatama Soft' at the top!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.name_en: Naoshima Art Island — Chichu Art Museum & Yellow Pumpkin (Naoshima, Kagawa)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: Yayoi Kusama's Iconic Ocean-Pier Yellow Pumpkin & Tadao Ando's Underground Monet Gallery (★4.9)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.access_short: JR Takamatsu Stn 5m Walk to Ferry (50m)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: Book Chichu Art Museum timed tickets online in advance and rent an e-bike (¥1,500) the second the ferry lands at Miyanoura!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.name_en: Marugame Castle — Fan-of-Slope Stone Walls (Marugame, Kagawa)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: Japan's Tallest 60m Stacked Stone Ramparts Crowned With a 1660 Original 3-Story Wooden Keep (★4.7)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: After descending the castle, eat Marugame's specialty 'Honetsukidori' (spicy garlic oven-roasted bone-in chicken leg) at Ikkaku!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.name_en: Chichibugahama Beach — The Uyuni Salt Flat of Japan (Mitoyo, Kagawa)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: 1km Tidal Mirror Pool Reflecting Golden Sunsets Over the Seto Inland Sea (★4.8)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: Check the 'Chichibugahama Sunset & Low-Tide Calendar' online — crouch down right at water level for the mirror reflection!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.name_en: Shodoshima Angel Road & Olive Park Windmill (Shodoshima, Kagawa)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: Twice-Daily Sandbar Path Across the Sea + White Greek Windmill Where You Can Fly on a Witch's Broom! (★4.8)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: Borrow a free wooden broom inside the Olive Park Memorial Hall to jump for a 'Kiki's Delivery Service' photo by the windmill!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.name_en: Gamo Udon / Yamagoe Udon — Sanuki Udon Pilgrimage (Sakaide / Ayagawa, Kagawa)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: Freshly Foot-Kneaded, Cauldron-Pulled Chewy Wheat Noodles Topped With Raw Egg & Soy ('Kamatama') (★3.95)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.access_short: JR Kamogawa Stn / Kotoden Takinomiya Stn
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: Most legendary field udon shops open at 8:30 AM and close by 1:30 PM — eat in the outdoor bamboo yard!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.name_en: Takaya Shrine — The Torii in the Sky (Kanonji, Kagawa)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: 404m Summit Stone Torii Framing the Entire Seto Inland Sea & Ibukijima Islands Below (★4.8)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.access_short: JR Kanonji Stn Taxi / Weekend Shuttle
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: On weekends, take the shuttle bus from Ariake Ground; on weekdays, a 15-minute taxi takes you straight to the upper parking lot!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.name_en: Shikoku Mura Open-Air Kominka Museum & Waraya Udon (Takamatsu Yashima, Kagawa)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: 33 Relocated Thatched Houses, Sugar-Press Barns & Vine Bridges + Thatched-Roof 'Waraya' Basin Udon (★4.8)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: Right at the museum entrance sits 'Waraya' — eat hot Kama-age Udon served in a large wooden tub inside an Edo farmhouse!

pref_kagawa_matrix_054.name_en: Kanamaruza — Japan's Oldest Surviving Kabuki Playhouse (1835) (Kotohira, Kagawa)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.dish: 100% Candle-and-Daylight-Lit Edo Theater With Bamboo Trapdoors & Hand-Turned Revolving Stage (★4.8)
pref_kagawa_matrix_054.hack: Step right down into the 'Naraku' basement beneath the stage to push the giant wooden capstan poles yourself!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.name_en: Iya Valley Kazurabashi Vine Bridge & Biwa Falls (Miyoshi, Tokushima)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: 12th-Century Heike Samurai Refugee Bridge Woven From 5 Tons of Mountain Actinidia Vines (★4.8)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: Look down between the 15cm-spaced wooden slats at the emerald Iya River 14m below, then try 'Dekomawashi' skewers by Biwa Falls!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.name_en: Naruto Whirlpools & Uzunomichi Glass Walkway (Naruto, Tokushima)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: 20-Meter-Wide Roaring Tidal Whirlpools Viewed Through Glass Floors 45m Under the Bridge + Wonder Naruto Boat (★4.8)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.access_short: JR Naruto Stn 20m Bus to Naruto Koen
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: Combine the glass-floor walkway with the 'Uzushio Kisen' small high-speed boat that circles 2 meters from the vortex!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: Japan's Largest Museum Floor Space: 1,000 Full-Scale Ceramic-Board Masterpieces Including the Entire Sistine Chapel! (★4.9)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.access_short: JR Naruto Stn 15m Bus / Direct Osaka Bus
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: Because every painting is fired at 1,300°C on ceramic plates, you can photograph and touch the textures inside the Sistine Chapel!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.name_en: Wakimachi Udatsu Street & Indigo Dyeing (Mima, Tokushima)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: 430-Meter Edo Indigo-Merchant Street With Fireproof 'Udatsu' Wings & 'Awa Ai' Dyeing Workshops (★4.7)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: Dip your own cotton handkerchief into a fermented natural 'Japan Blue' indigo vat inside the Yoshida Residence!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.name_en: Oboke Gorge Crystal Boat & Peeing Boy Statue (Miyoshi, Tokushima)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: 200-Million-Year Blue-Green Schist Canyon + Bronze Boy Perched on a 200-Meter Sheer Precipice! (★4.8)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: Take the local bus 15 minutes up the hairpin mountain road from the boat dock to the vertigo-inducing Iya Peeing Boy rock!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.name_en: Awa Odori Kaikan & Mount Bizan Ropeway (Tokushima City, Tokushima)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: Year-Round Live 'Fools' Dance' Performances With 30-Person Flute/Drum Troupe + Ropeway on the Roof! (★4.8)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: Audience members are invited on stage at the end of every show (11:00, 14:00, 15:00, 16:00) to learn the Awa Odori steps!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.name_en: Ryozen-ji — Temple #1 of the 88-Temple Shikoku Pilgrimage (Naruto, Tokushima)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: 736 AD Starting Point of the 1,200km Ohenro Circuit With Lantern-Filled Hall & Koi Pond (★4.7)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: You can buy the white pilgrim vest ('Hakui'), conical sedge hat, and Kobo Daishi walking staff right at the gate shop!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.name_en: Ochiai Village — Cliffside Mountain Hamlet (Higashi-Iya, Miyoshi, Tokushima)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: 390-Meter Vertical-Drop Mountain Slope Dotted With 18th-Century Stone-Walled Farmhouses (★4.7)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.access_short: JR Oboke Stn Bus to Kyokyo-bashi
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: Drive or bus to the 'Ochiai Pass Viewpoint' on the opposite mountain ridge for the full sweep of the vertical village!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.name_en: Oku-Iya Double Vine Bridges (Oku-Iya Niju Kazurabashi) (Miyoshi, Tokushima)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: 90% Fewer Tourists Than the Main Bridge! 'Husband & Wife' Vine Bridges + Hand-Pulled 'Yaen' Rope Cart (★4.9)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: Pull yourself across the river inside the wooden 'Yaen' (Wild Monkey) suspended rope box cart right beside the Female Bridge!

pref_tokushima_matrix_055.name_en: Tokushima Ramen Inotani / Todai (Tokushima City, Tokushima)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.dish: Dark Pork-Soy Broth Topped With Sweet-Ginger-Simmered Pork Belly & Unlimited Raw Eggs! (★4.6)
pref_tokushima_matrix_055.hack: Crack a raw egg straight into the hot broth and order a ¥150 side bowl of white rice!

pref_kochi_matrix_056.name_en: Kochi Castle — Complete Original Keep & Daimyo Palace (Kochi City, Kochi)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: 1749 National Important Cultural Property Where the Keep, Gate & Lord's Living Quarters All Survive Together (★4.8)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: On Sundays, step right outside Otemon Gate into the 300-year-old 'Kochi Sunday Market' (1.3km of 300 street stalls!)

pref_kochi_matrix_056.name_en: Hirome Market & Myojinmaru Straw-Fire Bonito (Kochi City, Kochi)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: 65-Stall Food Hall Where 1.5-Meter Straw Flames Sear Fresh Skipjack Tuna Right Behind Glass! (★4.9)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: Sit at a shared table first, then watch the roaring straw fire at Myojinmaru and order 'Shio-Tataki' (coarse salt + raw garlic)!

pref_kochi_matrix_056.name_en: Niyodo Blue — Nakatsu Gorge & Nikobuchi Crystal Pool (Ino / Niyodogawa, Kochi)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: Japan's #1 Water-Quality River Glowing Neon-Sapphire 'Niyodo Blue' Beneath a Cave Waterfall (★4.9)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.access_short: JR Ino Stn / Sakawa Stn Bus
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: Visit Nikobuchi between 11:30 AM and 1:30 PM on a sunny day when overhead sunbeams turn the waterfall basin electric blue!

pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: 47 Parapet-Free Concrete Bridges Built to Submerge Underwater During Typhoons Without Washing Away (★4.8)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.access_short: Tosa Kuroshio Nakamura Stn 15m Bike Ride
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: Rent a bicycle at Nakamura Station Tourism Center to ride out to Sada Chinkabashi (the longest and closest to the sea!)

pref_kochi_matrix_056.name_en: Katsurahama Beach & Ryoma Memorial Museum (Kochi City, Kochi)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: Crescent Five-Color-Pebble Beach, Pine Cape Shrine & Modern Glass-Deck Museum Over the Pacific (★4.7)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: Buy the ¥1,000 'My-Yu Bus' 1-Day Pass (50% discount for foreign passport holders = ¥500!) at Kochi Station!

pref_kochi_matrix_056.name_en: Chikurin-ji Temple & Makino Botanical Garden (Kochi City, Kochi)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: 724 AD Five-Story Crimson Pagoda + Dr. Tomitaro Makino's Timber-Canopy Subtropical Plant Sanctuary (★4.8)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: Both sit side-by-side on Mount Godaisan — walk from the curved wooden conservatory directly into Chikurin-ji's moss garden!

pref_kochi_matrix_056.name_en: Monet's Garden Marmottan in Kitagawa Village (Kitagawa, Kochi)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: The ONLY Garden in the World Officially Permitted by Claude Monet's Giverny Foundation to Bear His Name! (★4.8)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: Visit between June and October when the rare tropical 'Blue Water Lilies' bloom on the green-bridge pond!

pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: 175-Million-Year Cavern Where 2,000-Year-Old Yayoi Pottery Has Fused Directly Into Living Stalactites! (★4.7)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: Look for 'Kami no Tsubo' (God's Jar) near the exit — an ancient earthenware pot encased in solid calcium rock!

pref_kochi_matrix_056.name_en: Kiragawa Charcoal-Plaster Merchant Town & Cape Muroto (Muroto, Kochi)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: Typhoon-Proof 'Mizukiri-gawara' Multi-Ledge Plaster Walls & UNESCO Uplifted Ocean Magma Rocks (★4.6)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: Notice the horizontal tile ledges projecting from every white wall in Kiragawa — engineered to deflect ocean typhoon rain!

pref_kochi_matrix_056.name_en: Nabeyaki Ramen Hashimoto / Mayumi (Susaki / Kochi City, Kochi)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.dish: Boiling-Hot Earthenware Pot of Chicken-Soy Ramen Topped With Raw Egg, Chikuwa & Leeks (★4.6)
pref_kochi_matrix_056.hack: Drop a scoop of white rice into the bubbling clay pot after finishing the firm yellow noodles!

pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: 1687 'Nikko of Kyushu' Vermilion Main Hall Perched on 18-Meter Wooden Stilts + Hilltop Ocean Torii (★4.9)
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: Take the new glass cliff-elevator (¥300 includes a lucky charm!) or hike 15m up the red torii tunnel to the Ariake Sea lookout!

pref_saga_matrix_057.name_en: Arita Porcelain Town & Tozan Shrine Ceramic Torii (Arita, Saga)
pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: 1616 Birthplace of Japanese Porcelain — A Shinto Shrine With a Blue-and-White Porcelain Torii Gate! (★4.8)
pref_saga_matrix_057.access_short: JR Arita Stn / Kami-Arita Stn 10m Walk
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: Every torii gate, guardian dog, and lantern at Sueyama (Tozan) Shrine is made of fired blue-and-white Arita porcelain!

pref_saga_matrix_057.name_en: Okawachiyama — Village of the Secret Kilns (Imari, Saga)
pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: 3-Sided Cliff Fortress Valley Where the Nabeshima Clan Locked Away 30 Royal Porcelain Potters for 200 Years (★4.8)
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: Cross the ceramic bridge that plays a 24-note melody when you tap the porcelain plates with a mallet!

pref_saga_matrix_057.name_en: Karatsu Castle & Niji-no-Matsubara Pine Forest (Karatsu, Saga)
pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: 1608 'Dancing Crane' Sea Castle Built From Hideyoshi's Nagoya Castle Stones + 4.5km Million-Pine Coast (★4.7)
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: Climb the keep to see the 1 million black pine trees stretching like outstretched crane wings along Karatsu Bay!

pref_saga_matrix_057.name_en: Takeo Onsen Romon & Mifuneyama Rakuen (Takeo, Saga)
pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: 500,000㎡ Cliffside Azalea/Maple Garden + TeamLab 'A Forest Where Gods Live' Bathhouse Lobby! (★4.9)
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: Also stop inside the viral 'Takeo City Library' (Starbucks + 200,000 books under sweeping wooden arches) for free!

pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: 40-Hectare Moated Yayoi-Period Kingdom (300 BC–300 AD) With Reconstructed Watchtowers & Royal Burial Jars (★4.7)
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: Step inside the buried 'Kita-Funkyubo' mound where 14 actual 2,000-year-old clay coffin jars & bronze daggers sit in situ!

pref_saga_matrix_057.name_en: Yobuko Morning Market & Live Translucent Squid (Ika) (Karatsu Yobuko, Saga)
pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: Crystal-Clear Live Spear Squid ('Yobuko Ika-no-Ikizukuri') Sliced in 60 Seconds + Squid Tempura! (★4.8)
pref_saga_matrix_057.budget: ¥3,300 Live Squid Course at Kawataro / Manbo
pref_saga_matrix_057.access_short: JR Karatsu Stn 30m Showa Bus to Yobuko
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: After eating the sweet translucent sashimi, the chef deep-fries the tentacles and fins into piping-hot Ika-Tempura!

pref_saga_matrix_057.name_en: Ouo Shrine — Three Underwater Torii Gates of Tara (Tara, Saga)
pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: 3 Vermilion Torii Gates Standing in the Ariake Sea Where Tides Rise & Fall 6 Meters Every 6 Hours! (★4.7)
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: Visit at high tide to see the gates submerged up to their crossbars, or at low tide to walk right underneath all 3 on the seabed!

pref_saga_matrix_057.name_en: Ureshino Onsen — Japan's Top 3 Skin-Beautifying Waters & Tofu Pot (Ureshino, Saga)
pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: Silky Sodium-Bicarbonate Springs That Melt Off Dead Skin + 'Onsen Yudofu' That Dissolves Into Soy Milk! (★4.7)
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: Eat 'Onsen Yudofu' at宗庵よこ長 (Soan Yokocho) — simmered in alkaline Ureshino hot spring water, the tofu melts into creamy soup!

pref_saga_matrix_057.name_en: Kunenan — 9-Day Autumn Moss & Maple Villa (Kanzaki, Saga)
pref_saga_matrix_057.dish: 1900 Meiji Industrialist's Sukiya Villa & 60-Variety Moss Garden Open Only in Spring & Autumn! (★4.8)
pref_saga_matrix_057.hack: Even outside the 9-day November window, neighboring Niiyama Shrine's moss steps and watermills are open free year-round!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Gunkanjima — Hashima Battleship Island (Nagasaki City, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: UNESCO Abandoned 1916 Concrete High-Rise Coal-Mining Island Rising Like a Warship From the Sea (★4.8)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.access_short: Nagasaki Tram Ohato Stn 3m Walk to Pier
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: Book with Gunkanjima Concierge or Yamasa Kaiun online and sit on the RIGHT side of the upper deck for the island circle!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Mount Inasa (Inasayama) $10-Million Night View (Nagasaki City, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: Voted One of the World's New Top 3 Night Views (Alongside Monaco & Shanghai) Around Nagasaki Harbor (★4.9)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.access_short: JR Nagasaki Stn 7m Free Ropeway Shuttle Bus
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: Ride the Ken Okuyama-designed all-glass ropeway 20 minutes before sunset to watch the harbor lights ignite!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Glover Garden & Oura Cathedral (Nagasaki City, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: 1863 Japan's Oldest Western Wooden Mansion Overlooking the Bay + 1864 National Treasure Gothic Church (★4.7)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: Find the 2 'Heart-Shaped Cobblestones' hidden in the stone pavement right in front of Thomas Glover's 1863 house!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Shimabara Castle & Samurai Spring-Water Town (Shimabara, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: 1624 5-Story White Keep Built by Christian Daimyo Era + Carp Swimming in Clear Street Channels (★4.7)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: Visit the 'Shimeiso' villa where 3,000 tons of Mt. Unzen spring water gush daily into a garden pond filled with giant koi!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Dejima — 1636 Fan-Shaped Dutch Trading Island (Nagasaki City, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: 16 Restored Edo-Period Dutch Warehouses & Captain's Residence From Japan's 200-Year Isolation (★4.7)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: Rent a kimono for ¥1,500 inside Dejima to stroll the cobblestone streets and see the original 17th-century sea gate!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Hirado Castle & St. Francis Xavier Church View (Hirado, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: Iconic View Where a Green Gothic Church Cross & Samurai Stone Walls Frame Each Other! (★4.7)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.access_short: JR Sasebo Stn Bus to Hirado Pier
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: Pause on the stone steps of Komyo-ji Temple to capture Buddhist temple roofs and the Christian church spire in one shot!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Sasebo Kujukushima 208 Islands & Sasebo Burger (Sasebo, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: highest Island Density in Japan Viewed From Tenkaiho + Giant Charcoal-Grilled 'Sasebo Burger'! (★4.8)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.access_short: JR Sasebo Stn 25m Bus to Kashimae
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: Order a giant hand-pressed Sasebo Burger with sweet mayo and bacon at Hikari or Big Man before boarding the island boat!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Nagasaki Shinchi Chinatown — Shikairo Champon & Castella (Nagasaki City, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: 1899 Inventor of Creamy Pork-and-Seafood 'Nagasaki Champon' + Bunmeido / Fukusaya Gold Castella (★4.7)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: At Fukusaya Honten (founded 1624), feel the crunchy coarse 'Zarame' sugar crystals still clinging to the bottom of the cake!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Megane-bashi — 1634 Spectacles Stone Bridge (Nagasaki City, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: Japan's Oldest Stone Arch Bridge Whose Double Reflection in the River Forms a Pair of Glasses! (★4.6)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: Step down onto the riverside stone blocks to find the heart-shaped rock embedded in the embankment wall!

pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.name_en: Unzen Onsen Hell & Nita Pass Ropeway (Unzen, Nagasaki)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.dish: Steaming White Sulfur Fumaroles & 1,300m Alpine Ropeway Over the Ariake Sea (★4.7)
pref_nagasaki_matrix_058.hack: Warm your feet on the natural 'Steam Footbath' bench in Unzen Hell where geothermal vapor heats your soles without water!

pref_oita_matrix_059.name_en: Hells of Beppu (Jigoku Meguri) & Steam Cooking (Beppu, Oita)
pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: 7 Boiling Cobalt-Blue, Blood-Red & Geyser Hot Springs + DIY Geothermal 'Jigoku-Mushi' Steam Ovens! (★4.9)
pref_oita_matrix_059.access_short: JR Beppu Stn 20m Bus to Kannawa
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: Walk 3 minutes from Umi Jigoku to 'Jigoku Mushi Kobo Kannawa' to steam your own seafood and vegetables in 98°C温泉 vapor!

pref_oita_matrix_059.name_en: Yufuin Floral Village & Lake Kinrin Morning Mist (Yufu, Oita)
pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: Storybook Cobblestone Village Below Twin-Peaked Mt. Yufu & Thermal-Fed Steaming Lake (★4.8)
pref_oita_matrix_059.access_short: JR Yufuin Stn 15m Walk (Or 'Yufuin no Mori' Train)
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: Book the emerald sightseeing train 'Yufuin no Mori' from Hakata, and grab a gold-award 'B-Speak' roll cake right outside the station!

pref_oita_matrix_059.name_en: Usa Jingu — Head Shrine of 40,000 Hachiman Shrines (Usa, Oita)
pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: 725 AD National Treasure Connected-Gable Vermilion Halls in a Sacred Camphor Forest (★4.8)
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: Like Izumo Taisha, Usa Jingu uses the ancient 'Two Bows, FOUR Claps, One Bow' worship ritual!

pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: 61 National Treasure Heian-EraBuddhas Carved Directly Into Volcanic Tuff Cliffs (★4.8)
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: Notice the serene, full-cheeked face of the 'Dainichi Nyorai' centerpiece at the Furuzono group — Japan's first stone National Treasure!

pref_oita_matrix_059.name_en: Kitsuki Samurai Castle Town — Suya-no-Saka & Shioya-no-Saka (Kitsuki, Oita)
pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: Twin Vinegar-and-Salt Stone Slopes Connecting North and South Samurai plateaus (★4.7)
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: Pause halfway up Suya-no-Saka slope to look back down at the tiled merchant roofs rising to Shioya-no-Saka on the opposite hill!

pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: Japan's Highest Pedestrian Suspension Bridge: 390 Meters Long, 173 Meters Above a Twin-Waterfall Gorge! (★4.7)
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: Look out from the steel grating in the center of the bridge to see both Male (Shindo-no-Taki) and Female Waterfalls at once!

pref_oita_matrix_059.name_en: Rakan-ji Cliff Temple & Ao-no-Domon Hand-Chiseled Tunnel (Nakatsu, Oita)
pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: 1337 Cave Temple Perched on a Sheer Rock Face With 3,700 Stone Arhats & a Monk's 30-Year Chiseled Tunnel (★4.8)
pref_oita_matrix_059.access_short: JR Nakatsu Stn 30m Bus to Yabakei
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: Hold onto the ancient metal Spoon-Locks attached to the cliff wall and spot the monk's hand-pickaxe marks inside Ao-no-Domon below!

pref_oita_matrix_059.name_en: Mamedamachi Edo Merchant Town & Hita Geta (Hita, Oita)
pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: Tokugawa Shogunate Direct-Rule ('Tenryo') Town Famous for Kuncho Sake Brewery & Crispy Yakisoba (★4.6)
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: Order 'Hita Yakisoba' at想夫恋 (Sofuren) where the noodles are grilled undisturbed on iron until 50% crunchy!

pref_oita_matrix_059.name_en: Harajiri Falls — The Niagara of Kyushu (Bungo-Ono, Oita)
pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: 120-Meter-Wide, 20-Meter-High Curved Volcanic Lava Horseshoe Waterfall Set Right in Flat Rice Fields! (★4.7)
pref_oita_matrix_059.access_short: JR Ogata Stn 10m Taxi / Community Bus
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: You can walk right up to the water's edge at the top of the 120m basalt cliff AND cross the wooden suspension bridge in front!

pref_oita_matrix_059.name_en: Tori-ten (Toyotsune) & Seki-Aji / Seki-Saba Sashimi (Beppu / Oita City)
pref_oita_matrix_059.dish: Beppu's Beloved Tempura-Battered Chicken With Ponzu-Mustard + Fast-Current Strait Mackerel! (★4.7)
pref_oita_matrix_059.access_short: JR Beppu Stn East Exit 8m Walk
pref_oita_matrix_059.hack: Toyotsune Honten (founded 1926) serves the crispiest, juiciest Tori-ten in Oita for just ¥1,200!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: Rowing a Boat Through 100-Meter Columnar Basalt Cliffs Right Beneath a 17m Sacred Waterfall (★4.9)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.access_short: JR Nobeoka Stn 75m Bus to Takachiho
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Even if boats are sold out, the paved 1km cliffside walking path gives you the iconic top-down bridge view for free!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.name_en: Udo Jingu — The Ocean Cliff Cave Shrine (Nichinan, Miyazaki)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: Vivid Vermilion Main Hall Built Inside a Natural Sea-Cliff Cavern Over Crashing Pacific Waves (★4.9)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.budget: Free Cave Shrine (¥200 For 5 Lucky Undama Clay Balls)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.access_short: JR Miyazaki Stn / Obi Stn Bus
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Men throw the 5 clay 'Undama' balls LEFT-handed (women right-handed) into the rope circle on the Turtle Rock below!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.name_en: Aoshima Island & Devil's Washboard (Oni no Sentakuita) (Miyazaki City, Miyazaki)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: Subtropical Jungle Shrine Island Ringed by 7-Million-Year Straight-Ridged Wave Rock Shelves (★4.8)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.access_short: JR Aoshima Stn 10m Walk Across Yayoi Bridge
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Ride the white floral tuk-tuk ('トゥクトゥク') for free/tips across the bridge and throw clay plates inside the jungle inner shrine!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: Sacred Riverbank Cavern Where the Gods Danced to Lure Sun Goddess Amaterasu Out of the Dark (★4.9)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Every evening at 8:00 PM at Takachiho Shrine in town, watch the 60-minute live 'Takachiho Yokagura' sacred mask dance (¥1,000)!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.name_en: Sun Messe Nichinan — 7 Official Easter Island Moai Statues (Nichinan, Miyazaki)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: The ONLY Place on Earth Officially Permitted by the Rapa Nui Elders to Rebuild the 7 Ahu Akivi Moai! (★4.7)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.access_short: JR Miyazaki Stn 80m Nichinan Coast Bus
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Touch the 3rd Moai from the right for love luck, and the 2nd from the left for financial fortune!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.name_en: Obi Castle Town & Mossy Cedar Gates (Nichinan, Miyazaki)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: 280-Year Ito Clan Samurai Fortress With Giant Obi-Cedar Gates & 'Denpachi' Thick Sweet Omelet (★4.7)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Do the ¥200 quarter-shooting archery inside the castle ruins — hit the center bullseye to win an Obi-cedar prize!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.name_en: Ebino Plateau & Onami Pond Crater Hike (Ebino, Miyazaki/Kagoshima Border)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: 1,200m Volcanic Highland Linking Cobalt Crater Lakes Overlooking Kirishima's 20 Cones (★4.8)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Hike the 50-minute stone path up to the rim of Onami Pond for a jaw-dropping view of Korean-pine-ringed blue water!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.name_en: Ogura Honten — Birthplace of Miyazaki Chicken Nanban (Miyazaki City, Miyazaki)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: 1956 Inventor of Sweet-Vinegar Dipped Crispy Chicken Cutlet Topped With Homemade Tartar Sauce! (★4.7)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.access_short: JR Miyazaki Stn West Exit 12m Walk
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Tucked down a tiny narrow retro alley off Tachibana-dori — arrive at 10:45 AM before the 11:00 AM opening!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.name_en: Toi Cape Wild Misaki Horses (Kushima, Miyazaki)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: 100+ Protected Edo-Era Wild Samurai Horses Grazing Freely on Green Ocean-Cliff Pastures (★4.7)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Walk up to the 1929 white Cape Toi Lighthouse as wild foals graze right beside the road with the Pacific behind them!

pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.name_en: Miyachiku / Maruman — Miyazaki A5 Wagyu & Charcoal 'Jidori' Chicken (Miyazaki City)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.dish: 4-Time All-Japan Wagyu Olympics Champion Beef + Roaring Black-Charcoal Free-Range Chicken (★4.8)
pref_miyazaki_matrix_060.hack: Eat Miyazaki Wagyu lunch at Miyachiku right near the station, and hit Maruman at night for smoky black 'Momoyaki' chicken!

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.name_en: Sakurajima Active Volcano & Yunohira Lookout (Kagoshima City, Kagoshima)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: 15-Minute Ferry From Downtown to a Smoking Stratovolcano With a 100-Meter Lava Footbath! (★4.9)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: Pay your ¥200 ferry fare when arriving on Sakurajima, take the Island View loop bus, and soak in the free 100m Nagisa Footbath!

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.name_en: Sengan-en & Shoko Shuseikan UNESCO Garden (Kagoshima City, Kagoshima)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: 1658 Shimazu Daimyo Villa Using Smoking Sakurajima as the 'Mountain' & Kagoshima Bay as the 'Pond'! (★4.9)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.access_short: JR Kagoshima-Chuo Stn 25m City View Bus
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: Eat hot 'Jambo Mochi' (two bamboo skewers of sweet-soy grilled rice cakes) on the bench facing the smoking volcano!

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.name_en: Chiran Samurai Gardens & Peace Museum (Minamikyushu, Kagoshima)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: 7 Meticulously Trimmed 18th-Century Boxwood Samurai Gardens + Moving Kamikaze Pilot Letters Museum (★4.9)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: The stone-and-hedge gardens represent both dry-landscape islands and flowing waves against Mother Peak

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.name_en: Ibusuki Sand Baths & Tamatebako Ocean Onsen (Ibusuki, Kagoshima)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: Volcanic Heated Beach Sand Bathing + Cliffside Infinity Pool Facing Conical Mount Kaimon (★4.9)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.access_short: JR Kagoshima-Chuo Stn 50m ('Ibusuki no Tamatebako' Train)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: Ride the half-black, half-white sightseeing train 'Ibusuki no Tamatebako' where white steam puffs out when the doors open!

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: 1715 National Treasure Vermilion Mountain Shrine Where Ninigi-no-Mikoto Descended From Heaven (★4.9)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: Look at the branch of the 800-year-old Sacred Cedar ('Osugi') — a knot on the high right branch forms the silhouette of a praying priest!

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.name_en: Yakushima — Shiratani Unsuikyo & Jomon Sugi (Yakushima Island, Kagoshima)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: UNESCO Ancient Cedar Island With Moss-Carpeted Streams & 7,000-Year-Old Giant Cryptomeria Trees (★4.9)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.access_short: Kagoshima South Pier 120m Jetfoil to Miyanoura
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: Even without the 10-hour Jomon Sugi trek, the 3-hour 'Taiko-iwa' hike in Shiratani Unsuikyo gives you the full Mononoke moss forest!

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.name_en: Sogi Falls — The Niagara of the Toyo (Isa, Kagoshima)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: 210-Meter-Wide, 12-Meter-High Roaring Volcanic Basalt Cataract + Submerged Brick Power Plant Ruins! (★4.7)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: From May to September when dam water lowers, a 1909 medieval-castle-like brick power station rises out of the lake!

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.name_en: Kagoshima Kurobuta Tonkatsu & Shabu-Shabu — Ajimori / Kawakyu (Tenmonkan, Kagoshima)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: Sweet-Potato-Fed 'Kagoshima Black Pork' (Kurobuta) Dipped in Egg-Broth or Fried Extra-Thick (★4.8)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: At Ajimori in Tenmonkan (inventor of Kurobuta Shabu-Shabu), you dip the thinly sliced pink pork into whisked raw egg + dashi, not ponzu!

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.name_en: Tenmonkan Mujaki — 'Shirokuma' Polar Bear Shaved Ice (Tenmonkan, Kagoshima)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: 1947 Original Fluffy Condensed-Milk Shaved Ice Decorated Like a White Bear Face With Fruit! (★4.6)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: Order the 'Baby Size' unless sharing — the Regular size is a mountain of condensed milk, cherries, and beans!

pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.name_en: Amami Oshima Mangrove Canoeing & Heart Rock (Amami Island, Kagoshima)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.dish: UNESCO Subtropical Virgin Mangrove Forest Tunnel & Coral-Reef beaches Between Kagoshima and Okinawa (★4.8)
pref_kagoshima_matrix_061.hack: Time your paddle for high tide so your kayak glides off the main channel right under the low mangrove root tunnels!

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.name_en: Taketomi Island Red-Tile Kominka Village & Water Buffalo Cart (Yaeyama, Okinawa)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: White Coral-Sand Lanes, Coral-Stone Walls, Hibiscus Hedges & Shamisen-Playing Buffalo Carts (★4.9)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: After the water buffalo cart ride, rent a bicycle (¥500) to ride out to Kondoi Beach and star-sand Kaiji Beach!

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: 13th-Century UNESCO Ryukyu Northern Kingdom Fortress With 1.5km Winding Limestone Walls Over the Blue Sea (★4.8)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.access_short: Naha Bus Terminal Yanbaru Express Bus (120m)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: In late January, Japan's earliest dark-pink 'Kanhizakura' cherry blossoms bloom along the stone stairs of Nakijin!

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: Lord Amawari's Ship-Hull-Shaped Cliff Citadel Offering a 360-Degree Emerald Coral Reef Panorama (★4.8)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.access_short: Naha Bus Terminal #52/#27 Bus to Katsuren
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: Climb to the 1st enclosure at the peak where both the Pacific Ocean and East China Sea sparkle on either side!

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.name_en: Shurijo Castle Park — Zuisenmon & Kankaimon Gates (Naha, Okinawa)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: UNESCO Royal Capital of the 450-Year Ryukyu Kingdom + Live Traditional 'Bingo' Reconstruction Viewing (★4.7)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: Watch master carpenters rebuild the vermilion Seiden Main Hall through the giant glass observation windows before walking Kinjo-cho stone road!

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.name_en: Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium & Bise Fukugi Tree Lane (Motobu, Okinawa)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: 8.8-Meter Whale Shark Tank + 1km Shaded Tunnel of 20,000 300-Year-Old Fukugi Windbreak Trees! (★4.9)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.access_short: Yanbaru Express Bus from Naha Airport
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: After the aquarium, walk 8 minutes north to Bise Village to cycle under the cool emerald canopy of 300-year Fukugi trees!

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.name_en: Kouri Bridge & Heart Rock (Kouri Island, Nakijin, Okinawa)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: 1,960-Meter Straight Bridge Over Glowing 'Kouri Blue' Coral Shallows + Wave-Carved Heart Stacks (★4.8)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.access_short: Yanbaru Express Bus to Ago + Taxi
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: Stop at the South Beach parking lot right before crossing the bridge, then eat Garlic Shrimp at Tinu Beach!

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.name_en: Kabira Bay Glass-Bottom Boat (Ishigaki Island, Okinawa)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: Michelin 3-Star Turquoise Lagoon Dotted With Green Islets, Manta Rays & Black Pearl Cultivation (★4.9)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: Don't forget to climb the small 'Kabira Park Observation Deck' before boarding the glass boat for the 7-shade blue view!

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.name_en: Sefa-Utaki & Kudaka Island — Sacred Creation Sites (Nanjo, Okinawa)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: UNESCO Forest Megalith Triangle ('Sangui') Where the Highest Ryukyu Priestess Prayed Toward God's Island (★4.7)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: Buy your ticket first at the Nanjo City Regional Products Center before walking 10 minutes to the forest entrance

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.name_en: Kishimoto Shokudo / Shuri Soba — Wood-Ash Okinawa Soba (Motobu / Naha, Okinawa)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: 1905 Pioneer Using Real Wood-Ash Lye ('Aku') to Knead Springy Noodles Topped With Sweet Braised Pork Belly (★4.8)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.access_short: Yui Rail Shuri Stn 5m / Motobu Town
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: Splash a few drops of 'Koregusu' (island chili peppers steeped in Awamori liquor) into your broth halfway through!

pref_okinawa_matrix_062.name_en: Cape Manzamo & Zakimi Castle Ruins (Onna / Yomitan, Okinawa)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.dish: 20-Meter Coral Cliff Shaped Like an Elephant's Trunk + Gosamaru's 1420 Arched Stone Gate (★4.7)
pref_okinawa_matrix_062.hack: You are officially allowed to walk right on top of the 600-year-old curved stone ramparts at Zakimi Castle for sunset!

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.name_en: Goryokaku Star Fortress & Hakodate Bugyosho (Hakodate, Hokkaido)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: 1866 5-Pointed Western Bastion Citadel & Reconstructed Shogunate Magistrate Palace (★4.9)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: View the full star outline from the 90m Tower first, then walk across the moat bridge to enter the cedar-scented Bugyosho!

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.name_en: Matsumae Castle — Japan's Northernmost Edo Castle (Matsumae, Hokkaido)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: 1854 Matsumae Clan Coastal Fortress Featuring Its Original Stone Walls & Surviving Honmaru Gate (★4.7)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: Visit in early May when 10,000 cherry trees of 250 varieties bloom around the northernmost castle in Japan!

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.name_en: Shiryokaku — The Four-Pointed Star Fort (Hakodate, Hokkaido)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: 1869 Earthwork Star Redoubt Built in 2 Days & Nights by the Shinsengumi & French Advisors (★4.5)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.access_short: JR Hakodate Stn 25m Bus to Shiryokaku
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: Stand on the raised 3-meter turf ramparts looking straight down at Goryokaku and Hakodate Bay below

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.name_en: Hekirichi Jin'ya — Matsumae Clan First Bastion (Hokuto, Hokkaido)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: 1855 Japan's First Star-Shaped Western Coastal Defense Fort Built by the Matsumae Samurai (★4.5)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.access_short: South Hokkaido Railway Kamiiso Stn 15m Taxi
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: Walk the intact inner and outer earthen embankments and dry moats preserved in a quiet grove

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.name_en: Nemuro Peninsula Chashi Ruins Group (Nemuro, Hokkaido)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: 24 Coastal Cliffside Ainu Trench Fortresses ('Chashi') Overlooking the Sea of Okhotsk (★4.6)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.budget: Free Coastal Trail (Stamp at Info Center)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.access_short: JR Nemuro Stn 25m Bus to Nosappu
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: Walk the dramatic semi-circular trenches of 'Notukamafu Chashi' cut right into the grassy ocean headland!

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: 16th-Century Fortified Hilltop Stronghold Overlooking the Abashiri River & Sea of Okhotsk (★4.4)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: Combine with the red-brick Abashiri Municipal Museum at the foot of the fort hill

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.name_en: Shinori Date Ruins — 15th-Century Wajin Fort (Hakodate, Hokkaido)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: 1457 Medieval Earthen-Rampart Stronghold Where 374,000 Ancient Bronze Coins Were Unearthed! (★4.5)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.budget: Free Fort Ruins (Coins at Hakodate Museum)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.access_short: JR Hakodate Stn 25m Bus near Airport
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: Located just 5 minutes from Hakodate Airport — see the 4-meter-high medieval clay walls facing the Tsugaru Strait

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.name_en: Shiribeshi / Yoichi Unjo-ya — Matsumae Trading Post (Yoichi, Hokkaido)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: 1853 Preserved Samurai & Merchant Herring-Trade Headquarters ('Former Shimoyoichi Unjoya') (★4.6)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: Visit right before or after touring the Nikka Whisky Yoichi Distillery near JR Yoichi Station!

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.name_en: Shiraoi Sendai Clan Jin'ya Ruins (Shiraoi, Hokkaido)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: 1856 Date Clan Northern Defense Stronghold With Concentric Circular Earthworks & Samurai Graves (★4.6)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: Just 10 minutes from the Upopoy National Ainu Museum — inspect the 126-man Sendai samurai winter quarters!

hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.name_en: Benten Daiba &称名寺 Shomyo-ji Hijikata Monument (Hakodate, Hokkaido)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.dish: Site Where Shinsengumi Vice-Commander Hijikata Toshizo Rescued Surrounded Comrades at Hakodate Port (★4.6)
hokkaido_castles_samurai_063.hack: Walk from the Benten Daiba stone marker up the slope to Shomyo-ji Temple's cenotaph for Hijikata Toshizo

ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.name_en: Mito Castle Otemon Gate & Kodokan (Mito, Ibaraki)
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.dish: 1841 Largest Samurai Clan Academy in Japan + Newly Reconstructed Giant Two-Story Otemon Gate (★4.8)
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.access_short: JR Mito Stn North Exit 8m Walk
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.hack: Walk the newly restored Otemon Gate, Ninomaru Kakuyagura turret, and Yakuimon Gate along the giant dry moat!

ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.name_en: Tsuchiura Castle — The Turtle Castle (Tsuchiura, Ibaraki)
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.dish: 1656 Only Surviving Original 'Taiko Yagura' Drum Gate in Kanto Surrounded by Water Moats (★4.6)
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.access_short: JR Tsuchiura Stn West Exit 15m Walk
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.hack: Water used to rise up to the walls making the castle float like a turtle — don't miss the East and West Yagura turrets!

ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.name_en: Kasama Castle Ruins — Mount Sashiro Boulder Fortress (Kasama, Ibaraki)
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.dish: 305m Summit Stone-Walled Mountain Castle Built Among Giant Natural Granite Boulders &八幡台 Yagura (★4.6)
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.hack: See the 'Sashiro-ishi' giant boulder at the Honmaru peak and visit Kasama Inari Shrine at the mountain base

ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.name_en: Sakayama / Makabe Historic Town & Castle Ruins (Sakuragawa, Ibaraki)
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.dish: 16th-Century Makabe Clan Moated Stronghold & 100+ Registered Edo-Meiji Kura Merchant Houses (★4.6)
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.access_short: JR Iwase Stn 20m Bus to Makabe
ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.hack: Walk the concentric earthen walls and moats of Makabe Castle Ruins just 5 minutes east of the historic merchant street

ibaraki_castles_samurai_064.name_en: Oda Castle Ruins — Southern Court Stronghold (Tsukuba, Ibaraki)
