kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.name_en: Tomioka Castle Ruins — Amakusa Christian Rebellion Stronghold (Reihoku, Amakusa, Kumamoto)
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.dish: 1602 Peninsula Sandbar Fortress That Withstood 10,000 Rebels Led by 16-Year-Old Amakusa Shiro! (★4.7)
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.access_short: Kumamoto Bus to Hondo + Bus to Tomioka
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.hack: Stand on the Honmaru walls looking down at the narrow curved sandbar connecting the castle peninsula to Amakusa Island!

kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.name_en: Hosokawa Gyobutei — First-Rank Samurai Lord Mansion (Kumamoto City, Kumamoto)
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.dish: 1646 3,000㎡ Cedar-and-Tatami Mansion of the Hosokawa Clan's Brother With a Silver-Plated Tea Room (★4.7)
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.hack: Located inside Sannomaru just 5 minutes from Kumamoto Castle — admire the 'Gimpakuken' silver tea room and autumn maple courtyard!

kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.name_en: Honmyo-ji Temple — Kato Kiyomasa's 300-Lamp Stone Stairway (Nishi-ku, Kumamoto)
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.dish: 1611 Mausoleum Reached by 176 'Munatsuki-Gangi' Stone Steps Topped by a Giant Bronze Kiyomasa Statue (★4.7)
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.hack: Climb the 176 steep stone steps flanked by hundreds of stone lanterns donated by Kiyomasa's loyal retainers!

kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.name_en: Yamaga Lanterns & Yachiyoza Edo Kabuki Theater (Yamaga, Kumamoto)
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.dish: 1910 National Important Cultural Property Playhouse + 'Sakurayu' Silky Daimyo Bathhouse (★4.8)
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.access_short: JR Shin-Tamana Stn / Kumamoto Bus to Yamaga
kumamoto_castles_samurai_069.hack: Step inside 'Sakurayu' right across the street — reconstructed in traditional timber as the Hosokawa Lord's private hot spring!

iwate_castles_samurai_070.name_en: Morioka Castle Ruins — Iwate Park (Morioka, Iwate)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: 1598 Nambu Clan 3-Tier Granite Fortress Built at the Confluence of the Kitakami & Nakatsu Rivers (★4.8)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.access_short: JR Morioka Stn 15m Dendenmushi Loop Bus
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: Notice how the massive 14-meter granite walls are carved from local white 'Morioka Granite' — rare in northern Tohoku!

iwate_castles_samurai_070.name_en: Kunohe Castle Ruins — Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Final Unification Siege (Ninohe, Iwate)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: 1591 Vast 33-Hectare Moated Fortress Where 5,000 Kunohe Defenders Faced a 65,000-Man Imperial Army! (★4.7)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.budget: Free National Historic Site & Guidance Center
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: See the rare northern stone walls inside the Honmaru mixed with giant medieval dry trenches ('Horikiri')!

iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: 803 AD Sakanoue no Tamuramaro's 840m-Square Northern Frontier Citadel With Reconstructed 18m South Gate (★4.6)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.access_short: JR Morioka Stn 15m Bus to Shiwajo
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: Walk through the colossal vermilion 'Minami-Omon' (South Great Gate) and reconstructed 1,200-year-old earthen palisade walls!

iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: 1644 Date Clan Northern Border Stronghold ('Yashiki-machi') Lined With Yew Hedges & Thatch Estates (★4.7)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.budget: Free Lanes (¥500 Somen at侍屋敷大松沢家)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: Eat cold dashi somen or matcha inside the 1835 'Omatsuzawa Samurai Residence' looking out at the garden!

iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: 20-Hectare Full-Scale Recreated 12th-Century Heian Samurai Palace ('Kyara-no-Gosho') Used in NHK Taiga Dramas! (★4.7)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: Try on a free Heian court robe or samurai armor inside the Shinden-zukuri palace where 'Kamakura-dono no 13-nin' was filmed!

iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: 1189 Hilltop Cliff Where Samurai Hero Minamoto no Yoshitsune & Warrior Monk Benkei Made Their Last Stand (★4.7)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: Stand on the Takadachi pavilion overlooking the Kitakami River where Matsuo Basho composed his famous 'Summer Grasses' haiku!

iwate_castles_samurai_070.name_en: Hanamaki Castle Ruins & Circular 'Enjo' Bell Gate (Hanamaki, Iwate)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: 1591 Nambu Clan Hilltop Fortress Featuring a Reconstructed 'Nishi-no-Onkane-Yagura' Bell Tower & Toyosawa Gate (★4.5)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: Ring or view the historic castle bell tower before taking the bus to Hanamaki Onsen or Miyazawa Kenji Village!

iwate_castles_samurai_070.name_en: Mizusawa Samurai District — Goto Shinpei & Takano Choei Houses (Oshu Mizusawa, Iwate)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: Preserved Edo Foot-Soldier & Retainer Quarter That Produced 3 Giants of Modern Japan (★4.5)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: Step inside the modest thatched samurai house where Dutch-studies scholar Takano Choei and Goto Shinpei grew up

iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: 1627 Nambu Clan Mountain-Spur Fortress Overlooking the Entire Folklore Valley of Tono (★4.6)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.budget: Free Summit Climb & Tono City Museum (¥310)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: Walk 15 minutes up through the dry moats from the Tono City Museum at the base to the Honmaru observation deck!

iwate_castles_samurai_070.name_en: Ichinoseki Castle (Tamurajo) &舊沼田家 Old Numata Samurai House (Ichinoseki, Iwate)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.dish: Tamura Clan Hilltop Ruins + Intact 18th-Century Thatched Karo Elder Residence Right by the Station (★4.5)
iwate_castles_samurai_070.access_short: JR Ichinoseki Stn West Exit 8m Walk
iwate_castles_samurai_070.hack: Admission to the Old Numata Samurai Residence is 100% FREE — volunteer guides offer warm tea by the hearth!

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Minowa Castle Ruins — Takeda & Ii Clan Earthwork Fortress (Takasaki, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: 1512 47-Hectare Volcanic-Plateau Citadel With Reconstructed 'Guo-mon' Gate & Giant Dry Trenches (★4.7)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.access_short: JR Takasaki Stn West Exit 30m Gunma Bus
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: Walk under the massive wooden 'Guo-mon' gate standing directly inside a 15-meter-deep dry moat trench!

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Kanayama Castle Ruins — The All-Stone Mountain Fortress of Kanto (Ota, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: 239-Meter Summit Castle Paved Completely in Stacked Slate Stones Around a Sacred Circular Pond! (★4.8)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.budget: Free Ruins & Kengo Kuma Guidance Center
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: Unlike 99% of Kanto clay castles, Kanayama's walls, pathways, and 'Hi-no-Ike' ritual pond are completely stone-paved!
gunma_castles_samurai_071.photo_query: Kanayama Castle stone pond Ota Gunma

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Numata Castle Ruins — The Sanada Clan's Northern Kanto Stronghold (Numata, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: 60-Meter River-Cliff Fortress Built by Sanada Masayuki & Nobuyuki With Original 'Nishi-Yagura-dai' Stones (★4.6)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: Look at the surviving 16th-century Sanada stone wall at Nishi-Yagura-dai and the giant 2,000-year 'Gotenzakura' cherry tree!

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Mayabashi (Maebashi) Castle Ruins & Rinkokaku Villa (Maebashi, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: Tone-River 'Kanto's Greatest Castle' Site + 1884 All-Timber Meiji Imperial Guest Villa (★4.7)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: The 33-Floor Gunma Prefectural Office sits on the old Honmaru (free 32F observatory!), and Rinkokaku right next door is 100% free!

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Obata Castle Town &樂山園 Rakusan-en Daimyo Garden (Kanra, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: 1615 Oda Nobukatsu (Nobunaga's 2nd Son!) Samurai Canal Street &Gunma's ONLY Surviving Daimyo Garden (★4.8)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.access_short: Joshin Dentetsu Joshu-Fukushima Stn 20m Walk / Free Bike
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: Borrow a free rental bicycle at Joshu-Fukushima Station to ride along the cherry-lined 'Ozeki' water canal past samurai walls!

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Iwabitsu Castle Ruins — The Rocky Eagle's Nest of Sanada (Higashiagatsuma, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: 795-Meter Jagged Volcanic Crag Fortress Chosen by Takeda Shingen & Sanada Masayuki as Their Ultimate Retreat (★4.6)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: Featured in the opening credits of NHK's 'Sanada Maru' — hike 20 minutes from the平沢 (Hirasawa) trailhead to the Honmaru!

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Nagurumi Castle Ruins — The Spark of the Odawara Siege (Minakami, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: Terraced River-Cliff Earthworks With 10-Meter Deep 'Horikiri' Trenches Facing the Snowy Tanigawa Alps (★4.7)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: Stand on the 'Ninomaru' grass promontory for a dramatic straight-line view down three consecutive earth enclosures!

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Takasaki Castle Ruins — Dry Moat, Inui Yagura &東門 East Gate (Takasaki, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: 1598 Ii Naomasa Fortress Preserving Its Original 17th-Century Corner Turret & Relocated Gate (★4.5)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.access_short: JR Takasaki Stn West Exit 15m Walk
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: Walk along the cherry-lined outer moat and step inside the original Edo-period 'Inui Yagura' turret and East Gate

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Annaka Samurai Residences &の新島襄 Niijima Jo House (Annaka, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: 1830 Preserved Foot-Soldier Rowhouse ('Ashigaru Nagaya'), Gunery Magistrate House & Samurai Gardens (★4.5)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: Walk along the Nakasendo cedar avenue nearby after touring the 4-unit thatched Ashigaru Nagaya!

gunma_castles_samurai_071.name_en: Tatebayashi Castle Ruins & Azalea Hill Park (Tatebayashi, Gunma)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.dish: 1556 'Tail-Dragging Fox Castle' Protected by Marshland & 10,000 Giant 400-Year-Old Azalea Trees! (★4.6)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.budget: Free Castle Gates (¥630 Azalea Bloom Season)
gunma_castles_samurai_071.access_short: Tobu Tatebayashi Stn East Exit 15m Walk
gunma_castles_samurai_071.hack: Pass through the reconstructed 'Tsuchibashi-mon' gate and visit the 18th-century Tayama Katai samurai residence!
